event_text: An attack disrupts Allied Media's production servers; the Otago Daily Times is laid out by hand, and two smaller papers cannot publish
RNZ staff cannot reach wi-fi, editorial systems or the VPN
RNZ says it is investigating what it understands at this stage to be a cyber breach and has notified the National Cyber Security Centre
RNZ's Checkpoint programme reports the apparent attack cut access to some editorial systems and online services
